faq.question: Q1. What is DIC State Coordinator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Digital India Corporation has invited online applications to fill 12 vacancies for the State Coordinator post under the Poshan Tracker project on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for DIC State Coordinator?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies available distributed across various states including Andhra Pradesh, Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Gujarat, Jharkhand, Kerala, Lakshadweep, Maharashtra, Mizoram, Odisha, Puducherry, and West Bengal.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DIC State Coordinator?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is October 23rd, 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for DIC State Coordinator?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MA Economics, MA Political Science or be Any Graduate with relevant years of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DIC State Coordinator?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is 20 to 40 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for DIC State Coordinator?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for DIC State Coordinator?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates may apply online through the official application portal at https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DIC State Coordinator?
faq.answer: Shortlisting is carried out through an objective evaluation matrix based on educational qualification, relevant experience, domain expertise, and other criteria, followed by selection interviews for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the positions are purely temporary in nature for the project of Digital India Corporation, and appointees shall not derive any right or claim for permanent appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location after selection?
faq.answer: The place of posting shall be in Noida or New Delhi, but transferable to project locations of Digital India Corporation as per existing policy.
